evidence_class: static source observations and bounded interpretation
source_scope: Three selected files in the complete signed MIDI Remote factory-script tree

limitations: Caller-selected source analysis leaves 77 inventoried files outside analysis scope. Inventory identity covers the complete artifact; relationships through unselected sources remain unknown.
CommonJS and ESM binding relationships were recovered from inert syntax and resolved only within the inventoried artifact container.
Graph coverage is incomplete; unavailable facts remain explicit and must not be read as absence.
JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
Static imports, entrypoints, workers, endpoints, and storage relationships do not prove runtime execution.
Static paths and relationships may remain unresolved when expressions are dynamic or obfuscated.
Webpack/Rspack factories were recovered from AST literals; REA did not invoke push handlers or bundle bootstrap code.

declared_example_mapping.claim_scope: Source declares these calls and arguments; runtime registration, MIDI receipt, host lookup, scaling, takeover and feedback remain unmeasured.

api_file_interpretation.observation: The bundled API JavaScript includes empty increment/decrement bodies, methods returning fresh type objects without using supplied binding arguments, and takeover methods returning this without implementing takeover state.
api_file_interpretation.inference: This file serves as a development-facing API shape/stub, not sufficient implementation evidence for the native host behavior.
api_file_interpretation.negative_conclusion_disallowed: Empty stub bodies do not establish that Cubase ignores the corresponding actions.
api_file_interpretation.unresolved_boundary: The actual runtime module provider, native host bridge, object lifetime and value transformations have not been mapped.

tool_interpretation_correction.observation: REA assigns an electron-main role from package.json main in this selected SDK package.
tool_interpretation_correction.interpretation: The retained relation supports a package entrypoint only. It is not evidence that Cubase is an Electron application.

next_discriminating_work: Trace the native module-provider registration for the literal midiremote_api_v1 before inferring host semantics from the stubs.
In a later runtime phase, test one declared CC binding with recorded track/send selection and explicit takeover mode, preserving MIDI input, feedback and host-value observations.
